statement: Define W on positive integers by: W(1) = false; for m > 1, W(m) = true if and only if there exists an integer x with 0 < x < m and x divides m such that W(m - x) = false. Equivalently, W(m) says that the player whose turn it is at m can force a win. Whenever divisor_game n returns a result r, r = true if and only if W(n) = true, i.e. Alice, who moves first starting from n, wins under optimal play.
preconditions: n is an integer satisfying 1 <= n <= 1000.

statement: divisor_game n returns a result; it does not fail, overflow, panic, or otherwise enter the failure case of Result.
preconditions: n is an integer satisfying 1 <= n <= 1000.

statement: Whenever divisor_game n returns a result r, r = true if and only if n is even (that is, n mod 2 = 0).
preconditions: n is an integer satisfying 1 <= n <= 1000.
